metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Windhoek, Namibia (Point: 17.083, -22.57), buffered 30 km.
- Date: February 2021 vs. February for each year 2010–2020.
- Collections: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 SR (LT05/LE07/LC08) Tier 1 (fallback to Tier 2 if needed).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds, cloud shadow, snow, and cirrus using QA_PIXEL bits (1,3,4,5,7). Compute NDVI from scaled SR bands (scale 0.0000275, offset -0.2).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check image collection sizes (C1 if 0 after fallback).
- After masking, check valid pixel count (C2 if 0).
- If NDVI mean is null/NaN or out of [-1,1], return C3.
- Otherwise compare 2021 NDVI to baseline mean; print A if higher, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([17.083, -22.57]).buffer(30000); // ~30 km
    const scale = 1000;

    // Helper: total grid cells at 1 km
    const totalCells = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('const');

    function maskL2Clouds(image) {
      const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const bit1_dilated = 1 << 1;
      const bit3_shadow = 1 << 3;
      const bit4_snow = 1 << 4;
      const bit5_cloud = 1 << 5;
      const bit7_cirrus = 1 << 7;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(bit1_dilated).eq(0)
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(bit3_shadow).eq(0))
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(bit4_snow).eq(0))
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(bit5_cloud).eq(0))
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(bit7_cirrus).eq(0));
      return image.updateMask(mask);
    }

    function addNDVI(image) {
      const bands = image.bandNames();
      const isL8 = bands.contains(ee.String('SR_B5'));
      const nir = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(isL8,
        image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2),
        image.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      ));
      const red = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(isL8,
        image.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2),
        image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      ));
      const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.copyProperties(image, image.propertyNames());
    }

    function mergedLandsatCol(start, end, includeT2) {
      let l5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      let l7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      let l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      let col = l5.merge(l7).merge(l8);
      if (includeT2) {
        const l5t2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T2_L2')
          .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
        const l7t2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T2_L2')
          .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
        const l8t2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T2_L2')
          .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
        col = col.merge(l5t2).merge(l7t2).merge(l8t2);
      }
      return col;
    }

    function collectionStats(start, end) {
      let col = mergedLandsatCol(start, end, false);
      let size = col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // Fallback: include Tier 2
        col = mergedLandsatCol(start, end, true);
        size = col.size().getInfo();
        if (size === 0) {
          return {status: 'C1', size: 0};
        }
      }
      const ndviCol = col.map(maskL2Clouds).map(addNDVI).select('NDVI');
      const comp = ndviCol.median();
      const stats = comp.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const mean = stats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo();
      const count = stats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo();
      const totCells = totalCells.getInfo();
      const cloudPct = totCells && totCells > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 * (1 - (count / totCells)))) : null;
      if (count === 0) return {status: 'C2', size: size, count: 0};
      if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean < -1.5 || mean > 1.5 || cloudPct === null || isNaN(cloudPct)) {
        return {status: 'C3', size: size, count: count, mean: mean};
      }
      return {status: 'OK', size: size, mean: mean, count: count, cloudPct: cloudPct, totCells: totCells};
    }

    // 2. Target period: February 2021
    const tStart = '2021-02-01';
    const tEnd = '2021-03-01';
    const tStats = collectionStats(tStart, tEnd);
    if (tStats.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('2021 Feb Images: 0');
      console.log('No data for target period.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (tStats.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`2021 Feb Images: ${tStats.size}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking (target).');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (tStats.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`2021 Feb Images: ${tStats.size}`);
      console.log('Calculation failure for target period.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`2021 Feb Images: ${tStats.size}`);
    console.log(`2021 NDVI mean: ${tStats.mean.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${tStats.count}, Cloud%: ${tStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);

    // 3. Baseline: February of each year 2010-2020
    const years = [];
    for (let y = 2010; y <= 2020; y++) years.push(y);
    let baselineMeans = [];
    let baselineValidYears = 0;
    let baselineAttempts = 0;
    for (const y of years) {
      baselineAttempts += 1;
      const b = collectionStats(`${y}-02-01`, `${y}-03-01`);
      if (b.status === 'OK') {
        baselineMeans.push(b.mean);
        baselineValidYears += 1;
      }
      // Skip C1/C2/C3 years silently to keep concise output
    }
    if (baselineValidYears === 0) {
      console.log(`Baseline Feb 2010-2020 valid years: 0/${baselineAttempts}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels across baseline years.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const baselineAvg = baselineMeans.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / baselineMeans.length;
    if (baselineAvg === null || isNaN(baselineAvg) || baselineAvg < -1.5 || baselineAvg > 1.5) {
      console.log(`Baseline Feb 2010-2020 valid years: ${baselineValidYears}/${baselineAttempts}`);
      console.log('Calculation failure computing baseline average.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Baseline Feb 2010-2020 valid years: ${baselineValidYears}/${baselineAttempts}`);
    console.log(`Baseline Avg NDVI: ${baselineAvg.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 4. Comparison & Final Answer
    const delta = tStats.mean - baselineAvg;
    console.log(`Delta (2021 - baseline): ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);
    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error:', err.toString().slice(0, 200));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
